independent_review.body:
Independent bounded review of checkpoint241 at **defebb9e8799a77ac94f0cd06f7739a2108d23d8**, parent52d135b1a7f0b9f9521fa756079bcea5f68f781d: **three source-semantic corrections remain.** Passing hashes/tests do not clear these prose defects. No editorial acceptance or full-domain PASS.

1. **P2 — §371 evacuation subjects and veterinary responsibility.** The new meaning says nonprofit agreements cover “United States citizens, their families and pets.” The complete EH371 instead covers family pets of United States citizens who are evacuated by DoD, plus contract working dogs in the country. It does not add human evacuees as subjects of those agreements. Adjacent “provides no DoD veterinary-care authority” also overstates the printed disclaimer: DoD is not responsible for providing veterinary care by reason of evacuation. Preserve the no-reduction-in-human-evacuation-capacity condition. Suggested bounded wording: discretionary agreements for those citizens' family pets and contract working dogs; evacuation does not make DoD responsible for their veterinary care. Primary govinfo:hr3838eh-immigration-complete, full section371 [320947,322438), provider claim8.

2. **P2 — §534 invented mandatory Director rulemaking.** “The Director shall prescribe rules” is unsupported by the complete EH534. New3802(b) says regulations “may require” the listed information/notification actions; dated3809 and EO11623 authorize rulemaking/delegation and condition procedures on proposed rules, without establishing this claimed new mandatory Director duty. Replace with the literal discretionary regulatory formulation. Also correct “replaces3802(a)” to “replaces3802”: the bill strikes and replaces all section3. Primary EH534 [412250,415913), provider claim12; regulations clause [413086,413151). Preserve automatic registration, maintained-lawful-nonimmigrant exception, registration/induction distinction and unresolved benefit-law interactions.

3. **P3 — §1616 information ABOUT versus FROM.** The candidate says “receiving information from” a DoD cloud. The operative prohibition separately says “receive information about” any DoD cloud computing system. Preserve “about”; the indirect-access definition separately uses “from,” and must not substitute for that independent operator. Retain the defined-country citizenship predicate and its unresolved dated reference mismatch. Primary EH1616 [1369189,1372696), provider claim29.

Each affected paragraph appears in14active/audit fields: v38 defense provider mechanism/exact meaning; Immigration authoring meaning, membership rationale, universe reason/rationale; generated compiler_input/shared_action_core; both readable member details and action-observation details; semantic audit reconstruction.
